import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=50)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(occupation_activity)), occupation_activity.values, 
                      color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(occupation_activity))/len(occupation_activity)))
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Physical Activity Level by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(occupation_activity)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_activity.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution by Gender
bmi_counts = df.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Gender']).size().unstack()
bmi_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 2], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'], edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('BMI Category Distribution by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend(title='Gender')
axes[0, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Age Distribution with Sleep Quality
age_bins = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65])
age_sleep = df.groupby(age_bins)['Quality of Sleep'].mean()
axes[1, 0].plot(range(len(age_sleep)), age_sleep.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='darkgreen')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(range(len(age_sleep)), age_sleep.values, 
                        alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(age_sleep)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in age_sleep.index], rotation=45)

# 5. Correlation Heatmap
corr_columns = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[corr_columns].corr()
im = axes[1, 1].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(corr_columns)))
axes[1, 1].set_yticks(range(len(corr_columns)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(corr_columns, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(corr_columns, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 1])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values to heatmap
for i in range(len(corr_columns)):
    for j in range(len(corr_columns)):
        text = axes[1, 1].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                              ha="center", va="center", 
                              color="white" if abs(corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]) > 0.5 else "black",
                              fontsize=9)

# 6. Sleep Disorder Analysis
if 'Sleep Disorder' in df.columns:
    disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
    if len(disorder_data) > 0:
        disorder_counts = disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
        wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1, 2].pie(disorder_counts.values, 
                                                  labels=disorder_counts.index,
                                                  autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                                  colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(disorder_counts))/len(disorder_counts)),
                                                  startangle=90)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
        for autotext in autotexts:
            autotext.set_color('black')
            autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    else:
        axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data', 
                       ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
else:
    axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'Sleep Disorder column not found', 
                   ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
